steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Prick potatoes several times with a fork; place onto a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until potatoes easily pierced with a fork, 50 minutes to 1 hour. Remove, cool, and peel. Reduce oven temperature to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C).
Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels; crumble.

Combine pizza crust mix, water, and oil in a large bowl with a fork until dough comes together; turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 8 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes. Shape into a flat circle; place on prepared pizza pan. Build up edges slightly.
Bake in the preheated oven until crust firm and begins to brown, 5 to 6 minutes.

Toss potatoes with butter, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning in a large bowl. Combine sour cream and ranch dressing in a small bowl; spread over crust. Top with potatoes bacon, onions, mozzarella cheese, and Cheddar cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese melted and lightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

raw_recipe.headline: Baked Potato Pizza
raw_recipe.description: Perfect for Super Bowl parties or any other gathering, this pizza is loaded with bacon, green onions, cheese, and sour cream. It tastes just like a baked potato!

review.reviewBody: Really good! I think stirring the potatoes in the garlic-herb butter is what puts it over the top.

I was looking for something similar to what I used to get from a place in Mpls, and I finally found it! To cut down on the prep time, I bought a pre-made pizza crust, as well as bacon crumbles and I microwaved the potatoes on high for 5 min on each side until tender. I also added broccoli and chopped tomatoes. Delicious!

Cheated and used pizza dough from the local bakery. Then I accidentally peeled and cut potatoes before cooking. Easy fix is to put potatoes in single layer in a shallow dish, add spices and two tablespoons of water, cover and microwave for 2 min, let stand for five. Great as is.
We love this version of pizza! A great change from the normal. So good and not too much extra work if you just cook the potatoes in the microwave.
I made this for a party once and now it's requested EVERY time! Too make it even easier, I use a Boboli Pizza Crust. So easy and so delish!! Thank you for posting!
I had not heard of potato pizza before so I had to try it. I had frozen hash browns so I fried 2 cups before adding to pizza. Worked great

I forgot to mix olive oil in dough, still was good. There was so much of sour cream and ranch mixture, didn't use all on crust, but decided next time to put the extra on top if potatoes to give them more flavor. Can't wait to make it again!
This was awesome! I did peel and slice my potatoes and baked/roasted them...turned out great. Thank you!

So good. We lightened the amount of onions a tad because not all of our family cares for onions. Will be making this again for sure.

Plan extra time to make it. Our potatoes took a long time to cool before the next step.
Delicious and filling, quickly becoming a favorite at our house

I use scratch dough when making pizza, my wife and I love baked potatoes and I wanted to give it a go. Outstandingly delicious, although I felt I didn't put enough ranch sauce on so we just dipped it the leftover while eating. so good
other than using bacon bits and Walmart pizza dough, I followed the recipe. perfect seasoning on the potatoes makes this pizza. I make brunch for my church and it was a big hit there
Yum! If you ever had Green Mill baked potato pizza that they no longer make, this one is very similar. Very fun and different way to make pizza.
sinful and delicious...loved it! thanks for the post Brent BeSaw :-)
This is a great recipe for my favorite pizza. Thanks for sharing.

This was fantastic! I have been looking for a recipe for Baked Potato Pizza for years after having it at a place in uptown Minneapolis. I made my own crust and next time I will add a few more slices of bacon, just because I love it. Otherwise, this recipe needs very little tweaking. It's great!
I love this recipe. I omitted the green onions and it turned out great! I lovethe idea of tossing the potatoes with the seasoned butter. I will definitely make this again.
I LOVE THIS! If you like loaded baked potatoes, then you should like this. Just make sure the crust is cooked well. Mine could have been cooked a bit longer, but was still wonderful.
